svg.aria-label: Eventually perfect failure detector (◇P): Suspect whoever is silent; when you are proved wrong, wait longer next time.. ⟨HEARTBEAT⟩ every period; timeout with no heartbeat: suspect; a late heartbeat arrives after all; restore, and raise the timeout; nothing ever again; suspicion becomes permanent. After GST the timeout grows past the real delay, so mistakes stop: completeness always, accuracy eventually.
